verdict.rationale: Muse's marketed tasks (selling a car for more, negotiating a bill, planning/booking a trip, tracking subscriptions, checking out via Stripe Link) strongly imply it interacts with websites/online services to complete tasks, and its 'own computer' with terminal/file system plus ability to build custom tools/connectors suggests it can automate web-based research and actions. However, no evidence explicitly describes a dedicated browser-control mechanism (e.g., navigating pages, clicking, form-filling) as opposed to API/connector-based automation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of browser automation/navigation, hands-on demonstration of website research tasks, and independent confirmation that it reliably completes multi-step web tasks.
